title: Download a statement PDF
brief: Account holders download each monthly statement as a PDF from /accounts/:accountId/statements/:id.pdf. Same access rule as the statement list: only the account's own users, and a 404 otherwise. The route tests live in the API suite (a later group).

expected.why: The PDF route never calls requireAccount and loads the statement by id alone, so any signed-in user can download any account's statement by guessing ids.
